backgrounds.prompt: Create a polished original 16:9 WIDE animation BACKGROUND plate for a comedic educational history cartoon set in an imagined Dong Son riverside village, northern Vietnam over 2000 years ago. NO PEOPLE anywhere, no writing, no labels, no logo. This is production background artwork, not a concept sheet. Style: clean confident dark brown ink outlines, flat painted colors with subtle cel-shaded shadows, fine hand-drawn architecture details, whimsical but sophisticated historical cartoon, warm ochre bamboo and straw roofs against muted turquoise river and distant sage hills, natural perspective. Compose a real enveloping environment that fills the entire frame: left foreground shaded packed-earth riverbank with broad OPEN clear ochre ground for an animated presenter, ground fills bottom 28%; right and middle distance 3 distinct carefully drawn timber stilt houses with rounded/curved thick thatched roofs (NO tiled Chinese temple roofs), wooden stairs and railings, woven bamboo wall panels, baskets and pottery on porches, a canoe moored at the riverbank, gentle reeds. River curves from middle-left into right distance, early morning light with thin distant mist, warm sunlight on roofs, broad blue sky upper quarter, distant low mountains and palms. Eye-level three-quarter view, horizon at 45%, strong readable silhouettes, attractive muted saturated colors, detailed texture only through intentional line art, subtle cast shadows tying objects to ground. Avoid crude clipart, isometric infographic, geometric icons, empty white background, photorealism, 3D rendering, watercolor, painterly brushwork, modern objects. Clear foreground staging space is essential. 1920x1080 landscape composition.

Use the attached village artwork ONLY as the art-direction/palette reference. Make a completely new 16:9 wide shot: INTERIOR of an imagined ancient northern Vietnamese Dong Son bamboo-and-timber stilt house, intimate family kitchen in daylight, an empty animation background with NO PEOPLE, NO CHARACTERS, NO TEXT or logos. Clean dark brown line art, muted flat cel shaded cartoon colors, rich carefully drafted material details like the reference but simplify texture to broad readable shapes. Warm earthy ochre and dark wood with soft cool daylight through the open door at rear-left showing a glimpse of turquoise river and sage green landscape. Readable perspective: timber plank floor covers bottom 45%, bamboo woven walls, thick wooden posts, thatch under roof, clay pots and woven trays on shelves at back/right, bunches of rice hanging, small low wooden stool on the left. Foreground center-left must be EMPTY floor space for an animated child; middle right at approx 69% width and 69% height is a low clay fire hearth with a dark rounded pot above it on a wooden tripod, three stones around a small tidy recess with burnt logs BUT NO ACTIVE FIRE FLAMES OR STEAM (we animate these separately). Pot center near 71% width 53% height, hearth/logs near 71% width 73% height. Leave clear open staging area at 45% width for an animated adult beside hearth. Sunbeams fall through doorway, modest natural shadows, inviting humble home, no fancy architecture, no modern objects, no windows with glass, no metal kitchenware, no plate of clipart objects, no inset panels, no painted people. Attractive readable production background, not museum-certified reconstruction.
